commands.stdout_tail:
usage: train_bridge.py [-h] --config CONFIG --output OUTPUT [--resume RESUME]
                       [--init-bridge INIT_BRIDGE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG
  --output OUTPUT
  --resume RESUME
  --init-bridge INIT_BRIDGE
                        Initialize bridge weights only (for semantic-
                        reconstruction -> caption stage).

usage: real_trace_bridge_smoke.py [-h] --config CONFIG --trace-index
                                  TRACE_INDEX --output OUTPUT

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG
  --trace-index TRACE_INDEX
  --output OUTPUT

usage: validate_phase_a4_smoke.py [-h] --config CONFIG --report REPORT

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG
  --report REPORT

usage: generate_formal_baseline.py [-h] --condition
                                   {budget_text,full_plan_text,learned_latent,receiver_cross_attention,statebridge,text_homer,token_embedding,typed_learned_latent}
                                   [--label LABEL] --receiver {base,sft}
                                   --config CONFIG [--checkpoint CHECKPOINT]
                                   [--split {validation,internal_test,official_hia_unseen_test,official_hia_seen_diagnostic}]
                                   [--trace-index TRACE_INDEX] --output OUTPUT
                                   [--seeds SEEDS [SEEDS ...]]
                                   [--max-new-tokens MAX_NEW_TOKENS]
                                   [--slots-per-channel SLOTS_PER_CHANNEL]
                                   [--exclude-clusters-file EXCLUDE_CLUSTERS_FILE]
                                   [--quantize-bridge-output]
                                   [--allow-invalid-posthoc-quantization-diagnostic]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --condition {budget_text,full_plan_text,learned_latent,receiver_cross_attention,statebridge,text_homer,token_embedding,typed_learned_latent}
  --label LABEL         Output label for checkpoint variants; implementation
                        condition is preserved separately.
  --receiver {base,sft}
  --config CONFIG
  --checkpoint CHECKPOINT
  --split {validation,internal_test,official_hia_unseen_test,official_hia_seen_diagnostic}
  --trace-index TRACE_INDEX
  --output OUTPUT
  --seeds SEEDS [SEEDS ...]
  --max-new-tokens MAX_NEW_TOKENS
  --slots-per-channel SLOTS_PER_CHANNEL
  --exclude-clusters-file EXCLUDE_CLUSTERS_FILE
                        JSON file containing a validation_cluster_ids list to
                        exclude (outer-pilot eval).
  --quantize-bridge-output
                        Legacy post-hoc nearest-neighbor diagnostic; invalid
                        as a trained discrete method.
  --allow-invalid-posthoc-quantization-diagnostic
                        Acknowledge train/test mismatch; never use this output
                        as a candidate method.

usage: run_outer_semantic_confirmation.py [-h] --config CONFIG --checkpoint
                                          CHECKPOINT --output OUTPUT
                                          [--seeds SEEDS [SEEDS ...]]
                                          [--max-clusters MAX_CLUSTERS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --config CONFIG
  --checkpoint CHECKPOINT
  --output OUTPUT
  --seeds SEEDS [SEEDS ...]
  --max-clusters MAX_CLUSTERS
                        Only for a real-trace smoke; omitting it enforces all
                        40 sealed outer clusters.

usage: validate_outer_semantic_confirmation.py [-h] --output OUTPUT
                                               [--expected-clusters EXPECTED_CLUSTERS]
                                               [--expected-seeds EXPECTED_SEEDS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT
  --expected-clusters EXPECTED_CLUSTERS
  --expected-seeds EXPECTED_SEEDS

usage: formal_pipeline_monitor.py [-h] [--state STATE] --initial-job-id
                                  INITIAL_JOB_ID [--retry-round RETRY_ROUND]
                                  [--max-retry-rounds MAX_RETRY_ROUNDS]
                                  [--target-clusters TARGET_CLUSTERS [TARGET_CLUSTERS ...]]
                                  [--validator-repair]
                                  [--cache-resource-group {b-batch,c-batch}]
                                  [--training-resource-group {b-batch,b-batch-mig,c-batch}]
                                  [--training-gpu-count TRAINING_GPU_COUNT]
                                  [--poll-seconds POLL_SECONDS]
                                  [--confirm-absence-seconds CONFIRM_ABSENCE_SECONDS]
                                  [--once]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --state STATE
  --initial-job-id INITIAL_JOB_ID
  --retry-round RETRY_ROUND
  --max-retry-rounds MAX_RETRY_ROUNDS
  --target-clusters TARGET_CLUSTERS [TARGET_CLUSTERS ...]
  --validator-repair
  --cache-resource-group {b-batch,c-batch}
  --training-resource-group {b-batch,b-batch-mig,c-batch}
  --training-gpu-count TRAINING_GPU_COUNT
  --poll-seconds POLL_SECONDS
  --confirm-absence-seconds CONFIRM_ABSENCE_SECONDS
  --once
